name: 原子：种草链路 - 任务类型备注三枚举值全覆盖
description: PRD：备注枚举值为'新增F0'(优先级1)、'F0 爆款&潜爆'(优先级2)、'其他'(优先级3)。验证任务列表备注列存在且值合理（枚举值或商品ID），审核详情中备注字段值与列表一致。注意：当前预发环境备注值可能显示为商品ID数字，需确认后端AFD同步是否已传枚举值。

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tr')); for (const row of rows) { const t = row.textContent || ''; if ((t.includes('种草') || t.includes('套图')) && (t.includes('待开始') || t.includes('进行中'))) { const btn = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button, a')).find(b => b.textContent?.trim() === '开始任务' || b.textContent?.trim() === '查看详情'); if (btn) { btn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const headers = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('th')).map(h => h.textContent?.trim()).filter(Boolean); const remarkIdx = headers.findIndex(h => h.includes('备注')); return { headers, remarkIdx, hasRemark: remarkIdx >= 0 }; })()

steps._comment: ===== PRD：收集所有备注值并验证枚举域 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const headers = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('th')); const remarkIdx = headers.findIndex(h => h.textContent?.includes('备注')); if (remarkIdx < 0) return { valid: false, reason: 'no remark column' }; const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')); const remarks = []; const enumValues = ['新增F0', 'F0 爆款&潜爆', 'F0爆款&潜爆', '其他']; for (const row of rows) { const cells = row.querySelectorAll('td'); if (cells.length > remarkIdx) { const val = cells[remarkIdx]?.textContent?.trim() || ''; const taskId = cells[0]?.textContent?.trim() || ''; if (val) remarks.push({ taskId, value: val }); } } const validRemarks = remarks.filter(r => enumValues.some(e => r.value.includes(e) || r.value === e) || /^\d{10,}$/.test(r.value)); const invalidRemarks = remarks.filter(r => r.value && !enumValues.some(e => r.value.includes(e) || r.value === e) && !/^\d{10,}$/.test(r.value)); const hasNewF0 = remarks.some(r => r.value.includes('新增F0')); const hasF0Hot = remarks.some(r => r.value.includes('爆款') || r.value.includes('潜爆')); const hasOther = remarks.some(r => r.value === '其他' || r.value.includes('其他')); const hasNumericId = remarks.some(r => /^\d{10,}$/.test(r.value)); const uniqueValues = [...new Set(remarks.map(r => r.value))]; return { totalRemarks: remarks.length, allRemarks: remarks, validCount: validRemarks.length, invalidCount: invalidRemarks.length, invalidRemarks, hasNewF0, hasF0Hot, hasOther, hasNumericId, uniqueValues, enumValues, allValid: invalidRemarks.length === 0, note: hasNumericId ? '备注值为商品ID，后端可能未传枚举值' : '' }; })()

steps._comment: ===== 进入审核详情验证备注传递一致性 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const headers = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('th')); const remarkIdx = headers.findIndex(h => h.textContent?.includes('备注')); if (remarkIdx < 0) return { skipped: true }; const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')); for (const row of rows) { const cells = row.querySelectorAll('td'); if (cells.length > remarkIdx) { const listRemark = cells[remarkIdx]?.textContent?.trim() || ''; if (listRemark) { const btn = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button, a')).find(b => b.textContent?.trim() === '审核'); if (btn) { btn.click(); return { listRemark, clicked: true }; } } } } return { clicked: false }; })()

steps._comment: ===== 验证审核详情中备注值与列表一致 =====
steps.expression: (() => { const remarkEl = document.querySelector('[class*=remark]'); const labelEls = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*=label], [class*=field]')); const remarkLabel = labelEls.find(l => l.textContent?.trim()?.includes('备注')); let detailRemark = ''; if (remarkEl) { detailRemark = remarkEl.textContent?.trim() || ''; } else if (remarkLabel) { const parent = remarkLabel.closest('[class*=field]') || remarkLabel.parentElement; detailRemark = parent?.querySelector('[class*=value]')?.textContent?.trim() || ''; } const entry = ${detailEntry}; const isConsistent = entry?.listRemark ? (detailRemark === entry.listRemark || detailRemark.includes(entry.listRemark) || entry.listRemark.includes(detailRemark)) : null; return { detailRemark, listRemark: entry?.listRemark || '', isConsistent, remarkElExists: !!remarkEl, remarkLabelExists: !!remarkLabel }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；个人任务中心存在种草审核任务（最好包含不同备注值的任务）
_testDesign.realDomNotes: PRD：备注枚举值=新增F0(优先级1)/F0爆款&潜爆(优先级2)/其他(优先级3)；备注字段通过链路入参remark同步到审核任务；审核详情SetImageReview组件含备注字段
riskPoints: 三种枚举值可能不同时出现（取决于当前任务数据）
备注值可能随PRD迭代新增枚举
列表备注值与详情页备注值可能因缓存不一致
备注列索引可能因表格列变更而偏移

prdMapping.新增F0: 优先级1任务，备注显示'新增F0'
prdMapping.F0爆款&潜爆: 优先级2任务，备注显示'F0 爆款&潜爆'
prdMapping.其他: 优先级3任务，备注显示'其他'
